brief.vibe: A pale celadon brook with white thermal receipts running through it and one copper tag: calm, domestic, archival, a household ledger kept crisp.
brief.hero: Left column: a mono eyebrow, a large typed Recursive Mono H1 that prints in, serif lede, a dashed ruled mono price note and two tag shaped buttons (copper Purchase Plus, white Start Free); right and behind: a 3D receipt tape meandering across the full width with standing HSA tags.
brief.type: Recursive (variable, mono and casual axes) for headings and figures, Source Serif 4 for prose; set piece is the H1 printing like a receipt.
brief.palette: Light celadon field DCE8DF/CFDFD3, white receipt cards, ink 1B2622, one copper A04219/C25A2C for tags and the primary button.
brief.motion: Feed and Tear easings; a print head loader that prints load stages as receipt lines and tears into the hero tape; a low rail camera ride along the tape then a lift to a birdseye.
brief.speech: Two short imperative sentences in the H1; plain household second person; headlines state a fact or a negation ("What Brainbrook never does"); blog titles pair a claim with a colon explainer.
brief.rhythm: A meander spine swings across the page; each section docks on the bank opposite the swing; section labels ride the line as standing tags; media bands edge to edge.
